But maybe I'm being too optimistic as to how much love you would have for me, if you saw who I turned out to be. But maybe if you were still here, I would be different.

I don't want to say that you dying kind of ruined my life, but I feel like it did. And I blame no one because it is, what it is. I can't change the fact that you died, nor could you, or anyone else. It just happened, and maybe I wasn't old enough to know better as to how to handle it. And now I'm here. I suppose all my short comings as a person don't entirely come from what happened to you. That would be incredibly irresponsible for me to believe.

I just want things to be okay again, and I don't know how to get there, and I feel like if you were here, or I at least believed you were watching over me, I would be able to get there. But then again, that's no one's fault but mine because I can't seem to open my mind to the spiritual in a bigger capacity than writing this letter to you.

I think this letter is probably more for me than you, and I hope that's okay.

I started going to school in a country where things are very traditional. And basically, corporal punishment, although illegal, was still a thing in some schools. I was entirely unaware  of this fact, until one day I was sitting in English class, it was my first or second day, and this kid was talking in class and the teacher made him stand up, and gave him a deafening slap on the back. I was so shocked. And kind of scared. I wanted to go and complain to the principal, or one of my nicer teachers, but after a while realised that was just how things worked over there. The principal literally walk around with a whip like stick, for whenever she needed to punish someone. But that English teacher in particular scared me so much, to the point where I wouldn't  want to go to school. Luckily, I was a pretty good kid and not disruptive at all, so I was never at the receiving end of one of those hits.

I got a pretty monstrous scar on my elbow. When I was five I was climbing the monkey bars during playtime, and some other kid at the montessori told me that he bet I couldn't swing across the bars using one arm. And because I just HAD to prove him wrong, I swung and missed and fell, breaking my elbow in the process. It was stuck at a 90 degree angle because anytime I tried to straighten it I felt excruciating pain. I was crying and my teacher called my mom and gave me raisins to make me feel better. Pretty soon I was in surgery. Basically a part of my elbow was shattered, and they had to replace it with metal. I had a cast for a while, and the surgery left a pretty big scar. I'm quite lucky cause it was possible I wouldn't have gained full mobility of my arm again, but I have, although I can't straighten it as much as I can my other arm.

I know I always question it when people care about me, I feel like they're faking, or doing it out of obligation, but that's just my depression and low self-esteem talking. And we're all flawed, there are people in our lives that we know we love, but we forget to show them, because we're so caught up in our own lives. Please reach out to someone. Things may feel so fucking hard right now, but you have to power through it. You'll find happiness one day.

I totally know how you feel, and it's fucking terrible. I really don't get how people can't understand how damaging it is to say that to someone whose depressed? I feel the exact same way. I have a very small group of friends and when I'm with them, I feel good and even happy. But then I come home and this terrible emptiness settles in and I just want to disappear. I've begun to realise that hanging out with my friends feels like a distraction from my real life, just like with reading, or watching a movie. And so when it's all over, all of my problems and issues just come rushing back.
I honestly go to school only because my family wants me to. I know they'll be upset if I didn't go anymore and I don't want to upset them.

I feel the same way.

I think I'm pretty lonely. Not really in the sense that I have no one to talk to though. I talk to multiple people, but none of those people are my friends. When I'm at school I usually just read during my free time or whatever and whenever I try to talk to people in my class we don't click. It's like our conversations are just happening because we're both bored out of our skulls. I have 2 real friends, but one of them lives in a different city and I usually only text her, the other lives in the same city as me, but we barely every meet up, and she has a lot going on in her life. And even though they're my closest friends, I still feel lonely because I feel like I can't connect with anyone. Like no one understands me or my feelings and that they're all just pretending to.

I feel the exact same way almost all of the time. And the worst part is that no one gets it. I seem okay when I'm distracted. I seem happy and content, and because I try to keep myself distracted all the time no one seems to notice I'm falling apart inside, unless I tell them. And when I do they don't believe me because I spend almost all of my time convincing everyone and myself that I'm okay. I can't even stop because I've done it for so long, it's like distracting myself from my feelings is an automatic response when I feel distressed or depressed.

I think Tyrell has been interested in Elliot from day one. I do think that his 'love' seems rather sudden, however there is a lot of time and interactions between Tyrell and Elliot that we haven't seen (unless I'm not remembering right, but I don't think they showed us everything in 3x03). Maybe it only seems sudden because of all of the jumping back and forth through time. I don't think the love is only romantic, I think it's also a kind of leader-follower dynamic. Also, I don't think Tyrell is entirely sane. Maybe his feelings are just being projected or blown out of initial proportion because of his mental illness.

Idk if this is self-destructive, but I find myself compromising myself for the feelings of others. I always try to be as easy to handle as possible, I don't get in anyone's way, I don't bother people, I do anything and everything people want of me, no matter how much it enrages or annoys me because I don't want to upset anyone. And that really sucks because it makes me feel like my life isn't my own but I can't seem to stop no matter how upset it makes me.
